goal_one_line: Demonstrate, with a verifiable public ledger, that an agent firm can sustain itself: verified net income exceeding all operating costs, earned from positive-sum work, with zero integrity violations, within twelve months of T0.

definitions.verified_net_income: Revenue actually received from external counterparties minus ALL operating costs including compute. Booked revenue does not count.
definitions.sustained: Trailing-90-day net income positive for two consecutive non-overlapping windows.
definitions.positive_sum_work: Deliverables and bounty-style work where the counterparty gains. Speculation capped at 10% of revenue.
definitions.integrity_violation: Any of: misrepresentation to a counterparty; undisclosed agent identity where disclosure is owed; platform ToS breach; money moved outside the mechanically enforced caps; grading own work where rules require a separate grader. ONE violation = goal failed regardless of income.

gates.title: Plumbing proven
gates.pass_condition: tools/selfcheck.py exits 0 AND a g0_gate_result event with verdict PASS exists in JOURNAL.jsonl
gates.kill_condition: No further work until it passes.

gates.title: First verified dollar
gates.pass_condition: A revenue_received event exists in JOURNAL.jsonl with a counterparty and an amount > 0
gates.kill_condition: Full postmortem published; principal chooses redesign or wind-down. No silent extension.

gates.title: Positive unit economics
gates.pass_condition: At least one line of business where revenue per job exceeds fully-loaded cost per job over a pre-registered n
gates.kill_condition: Kill the losing lines mechanically; if none remain, treat as G1 failure.

gates.title: Sustainability
gates.pass_condition: The one-line goal met in full: sustained positive net income, positive-sum sources, zero integrity violations
gates.kill_condition: Goal failed. Publish the complete graded record.

non_goals: Not wealth maximization: surplus beyond a pre-registered runway reserve is allocated by the principal.
Not growth for its own sake: scale is a consequence the ledger licenses, never a target.
Not autonomy for its own sake: the human stays at the money and identity boundaries permanently; reducing that oversight is a goal violation, not an optimization.
Not being right, being calibrated: no stake scales until calibration beats base rate over a pre-registered n.
